goal: Deliver topic-conditioned, distance-attenuated associative activation across Python, local SQLite Recall and browser fallback, with reproducible positive/negative evaluation and auditable stopping reasons. This is an implementation experiment under adopted F1, not a new cognitive theory.

baseline.kernel: src/cora/cognition/activation.py: default max_depth=2, threshold=.15, attenuation=.65, max_states=25; relation strength has a positive .1 floor.
baseline.regression_reference: 453 CoRA tests passed after controller separation. Count is historical, not an acceptance target or semantic accuracy metric.

allowed_scope: CoRA activation/firing and directly affected Recall entry points, options and trace serialization
Browser fallback activation parity and UI indication of truncated/empty results
Synthetic public fixtures, meaningful regression tests and associated implementation/design documentation

Preserve unrelated in-progress work; do not require a clean baseline by deleting existing changes. Before edits record target HEAD, complete working-tree digest/status and environment. Use an isolated prepared checkout for the execution milestone; if a safe baseline cannot be prepared, report execution blocked.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify controller code, contracts, evaluator labels or protected evaluation data.
Do not change provenance-owner path eligibility or convert associative paths into evidence/relationship paths.
Do not mutate stored state/relation weights or create abstractions during a pure Recall query.
No automatic abstract identity merge, Knowledge approval/storage migration, F2-F8 policy changes, private source modification or new external data/model dependency.

Implementation workers must not commit/push while the task runs. Per the later explicit user instruction, the parent finalizes commit/push after each delivery, preserving incomplete status on a dedicated branch. No automatic merge/deploy or background scheduler activation.

implementation_candidate.status: Authorized to try and revise implementation details within the fixed F1/acceptance boundaries; record every material alternative and outcome. Not a canonical cognitive equation.
implementation_candidate.distance: Start with traversed edge count from a cue-selected focus, not absolute hierarchy depth, screen coordinates or abstraction level. Edges must already exist in experience-grounded structure; no semantic nearest-neighbor graph creation.
implementation_candidate.propagation: For a path p, use A_p(v)=s(f)*product(alpha*w_norm(e)*r(q,e,context)). A(v) is the maximum supported path score, not a sum of repeated paths. This prevents cyclic amplification. Keep alternative grounding paths under their existing separate provenance policy.

parameters.relation_strength_range: [0,1], actual zero stays zero; no artificial positive floor

implementation_candidate.convergence: A path of d hops is bounded by alpha^d for seed <=1; scores below epsilon do not propagate or become activated results. Equality with epsilon remains eligible. Stale/non-improving queue entries do not expand again.
implementation_candidate.topic_relevance: Define and document a deterministic, experience-grounded query/context relevance policy usable without new model services. Use cue-selected structure/support/provenance context where appropriate. Do not equate literal query-token overlap with relevance, nor default every existing edge to relevance=1. Kernel tests may inject factors, but integrated topical tests must exercise the actual production relevance computation, never injected fixture labels.
implementation_candidate.limits: Default propagation must not stop at two hops. Optional legacy hop caps and state/work limits are resource guards, never semantic definitions. Explicit limits must be respected and disclosed as truncation, distinct from epsilon/frontier exhaustion.
implementation_candidate.compatibility: Preserve existing evidence links, focused graph/provenance paths, working-memory scope, historical Recall read-only behavior and additive old trace deserialization. New option defaults and legacy cap behavior must be documented.

criteria.requirement: K01: identical edges/weights/relevance with changed abstraction-level, absolute-depth and visual-layout metadata produce identical scores, eligible IDs and stopping reason.

K02/K03/K04: reference unit-factor chain follows .65^d, reaches beyond two hops, excludes d=7 for epsilon=.05, includes score exactly epsilon, and blocks zero-weight/relevance transmission. Prove the bound for supported parameters.

I01/I02: fixed integrated cases include a nearer unrelated branch and a farther relevant association with no literal query-token overlap. Actual production relevance must suppress the former and retain the latter. Report false activation, missed activation, paths and relevance reasons; kernel injection alone cannot pass.

K05/K06: cycles and multiple paths never amplify scores or exceed configured budgets; strongest-path result is deterministic and independent of adjacency order. State count includes seeds and never exceeds cap; handle duplicate seeds and bounded updates.

K07: reject NaN/infinity, invalid factors/limits, missing seed IDs and unsupported parameters with actionable errors across exposed routes. Define zero/empty seed handling and exact threshold boundary. No silent clamping of invalid configuration.

K08: record policy/version, actual parameters, focus IDs/scores, selected path distance/relevance basis, stopping reason and whether result is truncated. Separate threshold, exhausted frontier and resource guard. Legacy traces still deserialize.

I03: use the same controlled fixture in Python kernel/associative Recall, SQLite natural-language Recall and actual executed browser JS fallback. Compare seeds/factors or explain their layers, then eligible IDs/scores/stopping at the kernel boundary. A string search or rendered screenshot is not JS execution; unavailable browser execution blocks parity completion.

I04: existing owner/provenance, direct-hit evidence, citation, historical query and working-memory quality gates pass. A cognitive association must never be presented as a new observed relationship or empirical support.
I05: stable before/after model snapshots show no node/edge/weight/grounding changes on pure activation/Recall. Allowed activation logs are separately identified; original source stores unchanged.

All new targeted tests, protected evaluator cases and existing CoRA suite pass on the final tree; record command, environment, tree digest, output and limitations. Never weaken existing expected outcomes merely to accept this implementation.

Independent reviewer reads contract, fixed evaluator cases, actual diff and observed outputs. No unresolved blocking issue or undisclosed evaluation omission. If a necessary semantic decision cannot fit these boundaries, request an owner decision rather than declaring completion.

deliverables: Implementation and route-specific tests in CoRA, including tests/test_distance_decay_activation.py

execution_policy.note: Pass the limits explicitly to the runner; descriptive fields do not change CLI limits. No monetary metering implemented. This prepares a contract only, not a live run.
execution_policy.retry: Fix implementation/test harness defects within the stated budget. Do not retry valid negative semantic judgments until they pass or erase failed attempts.
notify_owner: Changing F1 meaning, expected evaluator labels, core provenance contracts or acceptance criteria
A new model/service/private-data dependency or a material quality/cost tradeoff
Required route unavailable, unsafe baseline, repeated failure or budget exhaustion
autonomous_choices: Implementation structure, queue/data structures, local normalization/relevance candidates and efficiency improvements within fixed semantics
Related regression tests and documentation updates
execution_policy.completion: Only current-tree evidence and passing checks/review qualify. documentation_sync is injected by the controller and must also pass. Missing parity or pending decisions cannot be marked complete.
execution_policy.preflight: User explicitly requested F1 development after reviewing this contract. The isolated cora-f1 checkout and test environment are prepared; baseline/authorization recorded in controller .local/preflight/F1/baseline.json. Proceed with development under the existing fixed criteria. Do not require a second approval for this pilot; labels remain synthetic and not empirical gold.
execution_policy.publication: User subsequently requested commit/push after each delivery. Parent finalization may publish an explicitly incomplete experimental branch; this does not satisfy completion criteria or authorize merge/deploy.

acceptance_evaluation.status: Fixed acceptance cases; changes require explicit owner decision. Synthetic only.

cases.name: metadata invariance
cases.expected: Changing only node type/level/depth/layout leaves activation unchanged.

cases.name: long chain
cases.note: Reference factors=1. No default two-hop cap. max_states>=8.

cases.name: zero barriers
cases.expected: A zero-weight edge or zero-relevance edge does not transmit. No .1 floor.

cases.name: cycle
cases.expected: Finite bounded activation, seed not amplified; adjacency ordering leaves score map unchanged.

cases.name: diamond and budgets
cases.expected: For multiple paths retain maximum product, not sum; count seeds in state limit, deduplicate seeds, report resource truncation honestly.

cases.name: invalid configuration
cases.expected: NaN/infinite or out-of-range factors/limits and missing seed IDs are rejected, not silently accepted.

cases.name: near irrelevant, far relevant

nodes.Delegation: Transferring a decision to an assistant while retaining a veto
nodes.Decision ownership: Who can accept or override the selected action
nodes.Agency logo file: A visual branding asset; no connection to decision authority

cases.evidence_context: First two relations are grounded in discussion of human-AI decision control. Logo link is merely a document mention, not decision authority. Fixture construction must encode these distinct observed contexts using normal production graph metadata. Do not special-case labels.

cases.name: cross-topic control
cases.context: The logo belongs to brand visual assets; the human-AI decision-control branch is unrelated to this query.
cases.expected: Production relevance changes with cue/context and does not propagate brand-only context into decision ownership. Use normal query/seed selection, not evaluator-provided relevance scores.

cases.name: route parity
cases.expected: Execute actual browser JS plus Python/SQLite paths on shared controlled inputs; compare kernel results and distinct presentation policies separately.

cases.name: grounding preservation
cases.expected: Associative reachability never adds an owner/provenance relationship, new evidence or empirical support.

cases.name: read-only model
cases.expected: Before/after canonical graph identical; activation audit logs separated.

acceptance_evaluation.label_authority: Agent-proposed synthetic contract labels, not user-certified empirical gold. Prepared for owner review before the first live milestone.
